input.summary:
room: landing 2 furnished as a bench landing: oak-stair bench under the rear window with a fence table and lamp, two stair chairs, a dark-oak cupboard with a flower pot on the east wall, and standing lanterns on the floor.
make.sh gives a whole build.nbt; the part places 12 blocks with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE lines.
Room check says OK: walk reaches 35 of 36 floor cells (the one unreached is the cell above the cupboard pot), min light 10, no dark cells, no floating or unsupported blocks.

waste.what: Furniture cells worked out by hand in the layers() text rows, then rebuilt once after a row-count slip (two 11-row arrays where 9 were needed) and once more when hanging lanterns failed.
waste.cost: 2 extra make.sh runs and about 3 edits to parts/room-16.mjs
waste.tool: A room-furnish helper, or a plan --rooms option that returns the free floor grid with lantern spots, would have cut the hand-counting. mcd room already suggests lantern spots, but I did not use them.

waste.what: Checked whether the loft floor at y 23 exists over the room by running mcd check after the build, to find hanging lanterns floating in air.
waste.cost: 1 build plus 1 check run; the room check did not report the missing ceiling
waste.tool: mcd room should flag a lantern with no block above it (or a missing ceiling) as it sets the light spots, so the hanging design fails before the build.

waste.what: Looked at the room only from above with the roof cut away. The render is too small to judge the furniture, and rooms only makes an eye view for rooms 5+ cells wide, which this 4-wide room is not.
waste.cost: 1 render, judged as read-only at small scale
waste.tool: A --scale or --zoom option for rooms --out, or an inside eye view for narrow rooms.

companions.task: Check the light plan for the rear window bench and the cupboard, and confirm where a hanging lantern can hang once the loft floor at y 23 is built, so the room can use ceiling lights instead of floor lanterns.
Check the head clearance and the entry into this room from flight 2's top at (22..23,19,12), so the x 22 lane and row z 11 stay clear.
Make the bench and table as proper joinery (fitted seats, a table top) so the focal piece reads as furniture rather than stairs and a fence.

left: Skylit feel is not achieved: the roof and loft floor at y 23 are outside this box, so no skylight or hanging ceiling lanterns could be built here. Light comes from two floor lanterns and the table lamp (min 10, no dark cell).

The walk verdict reports 35 of 36 floor cells reached; the unreached cell is the one above the cupboard's flower pot (25,22,9), which is not a real route to a bed, table or workstation, so the verdict stays OK.
The room image from above is too small to judge the furniture, and no inside eye view was produced (the room is 4 wide, under the threshold). The bench and table read at a glance only from the data.
plan.md and elements.md have no checklist item of their own for landing 2 (only the general 'all rooms >= 8' light item, which this room meets at min 10), so no tick was made.
